document: Form PENS.E/6-B - Payment Instructions for a Withdrawal Settlement (less than 5 years of contributory service)

chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/6-B is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/6-B requests payment of a withdrawal settlement for participants with less than 5 years of contributory service.

chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/6-B
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant information; Section 2 - Bank account information (payee name, bank, account number/IBAN, bank ID code, currency, account type, bank address, intermediary bank, additional bank account information); Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.heading: Key acknowledgement: withdrawal settlement extinguishes other rights
chunks.text: By signing, the participant acknowledges that a withdrawal settlement extinguishes all rights to other entitlements, and confirms enclosing a valid government photo ID and a recent bank statement/document showing all banking information.
